selection_rule: Last completed self-play generation after development; primary611 chosen before evaluation

metrics.contacts: Any robot pair center distance below0.183m, sampled every5ms; fraction of match physics samples
metrics.field_exit: Any robot center outside x+-4.41m/y+-2.91m; count every affected match
metrics.acquisition: At least0.3s exclusive mouth control and ball/robot relative speed below0.25m/s
metrics.reception: Different teammate stably acquires an actual pass within5s, with>=0.5m displacement and no intervening opponent stable acquisition
metrics.counterattack: After a turnover, stable team control advances ball>=0.75m within10s before another loss, goal, ball-out or referee restart
metrics.support_distance: Distance moved while the neural support head is selected and robot does not hold ball; cover is separate
metrics.wins_draws: Only complete45s matches receive W/D/L; unfinished matches reported separately
metrics.goal_scope: Goals/passes/receptions include both sides; these gates test running-match functionality, not a guaranteed win rate

boundaries: no hardware or complete live ROS graph claim
